selection.algorithm: random.Random(42); sorted strata and task IDs; one choice per stratum
selection.scope: Two independent humans rate the same 27 outputs; no extrapolation to the full grid. Failures and missing reports are retained; no outcome-based replacement or reseeding.

resources_by_tier.scope: All runs, including failures and exploration. Memory scopes remain separate; unavailable samples are omitted with explicit counts, not imputed as zero. Host model RSS excludes Metal allocations and Docker VM memory.

scope: 252 automatic observations, averaged within input over two repeats; 27 human-rated outputs only. No imputation or full-grid human-quality estimate. Explicit/chart passes combine human scores and frozen gates. A visualization with absent plotted data fails plotted_data_match_mean; raw absent arrays remain null in automatic_runs. RSS units are MiB; exclude Metal and Docker VM; missing resource samples are not zero.

numerical_transitions.scope: Numerical table score of first candidate versus selected final output. Failed or unavailable initial computations score wrong under the frozen evaluator; unavailable final outputs likewise remain recorded failures. An initially matching table need not have had a usable report; this is not human repair or regression success.

paired_variants.scope: Repetitions averaged within each input; pairs then equally weighted. A clean task reused by two variants appears in both pairs. Different variants may have different valid reference answers. Numerical match only; pairs and shared families are not independent samples. No new inferential interval or human quality score.

secondary_numerical_analysis.scope: Automatic numerical observations only; independent human scores pending.

timing.scope: Server loading, prompt plus generation computation, and client-call wall time are separate measurements. A run missing any call measurement has no corresponding total; task means use measured runs only and retain their counts. Sequential warm-cache study, not controlled cold-start inference.
